scope: Saved profiled TP16 width8 run; seven available ranks; three rounds each. Hot summary excludes first round. No new device work. Task sums include each collective once and are not measured end-to-end removable latency.

classification.head: MatMulV3 with exact second input [9680,6144], BF16 inputs and FP32 output
classification.chain: M1 static graph, eighteen calls in six-call groups
classification.target: M8 dynamic head outside backbone graph
classification.conditioned: M8 static graph, one per round
classification.gather: One count=9680 or 77440 FP32 AllGather between each head and its same-stream/model ArgMax
classification.sampling: Greedy ArgMaxV2 over 154880 logits, then INT32 to INT64 Cast; no stochastic sampler
